answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 9541 Country: India Title: Assalam-Alaikum Brother My problem is that i am ready to perform Sunnat of Nikah, But due to some dispute of bride being from outside of the family some of my family members are denying to accept the proposal. Question: Assalam-Alaikum Brother My problem is that i am ready to perform Sunnat of Nikah, But due to some dispute of bride being from outside of the family some of my family members are denying to accept the proposal. But i am ready and happy with it. In this case can we perform nikah appointing our nearest friends as a witness. Answer ID: 9541 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 46/43=L/1429) In the abovementioned case, you can marry in the presence of family members of the girl along with your close friends. But, you should try that your family members and relatives also participate in the Nikah ceremony. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
